description: Router-level navigation helpers installed from router.ts: query parameters preserved across redirects by namespace (session-storage backed, with a router guard), and the redirect of unmatched paths to root with a bounded warning report. Combined because both are router guards installed at the same seam with no other owner.

characterizationScenarios.name: Preserved query parameters survive redirects and are merged back by namespace
Unmatched routes redirect to root and report a bounded path

compatibilityPromises: Unclassified callers may import these internals during inventory; imports from classified domains remain subject to cross-domain rules.
Preserved-query namespaces and the Comfy.PreservedQuery session-storage prefix keep their names because auth, workspace, and settings URL loaders read them.
preservedQueryDefinitions typing against the tracker remains visible as role-boundary debt; classification does not grant dependency exceptions.
